ida: quick report - my async sample harness started permitting spuriously high bursts after a flurry of 429s. captured a response that looks contradictory.

chris: can you paste the raw headers + how you reproduced? sounds like the quota vs ratelimit merge race.

ida: here's one 429 from the gateway while running concurrency=40:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 900
X-RateLimit-Remaining: -2
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1718000000
X-Quota-Limit: 900
X-Quota-Remaining: 5
X-Quota-Window: 60
Retry-After: 120000
Content-Type: application/json
```

misha: two problems: negative remaining should be clamped to 0 immediately; and when both quota & ratelimit are present we should take a conservative merge (safe-min) instead of last-write. also canonicalize header keys to lower-case first.

chris: for Retry-After parsing prefer Retry-After-MS header when present (ms -> seconds). if only Retry-After exists, parse as seconds but use a simple heuristic: if value > 3600 treat as ms and divide by 1000. document the heuristic.

misha: API suggestion: expose tiny pure helpers in redwood.sdk.ratelimits: parse_retry_after(headers: Mapping[str,str]) -> float and parse_rate_meta(headers: Mapping[str,str]) -> RateMeta (TypedDict limit/remaining/reset). keep them pure so sync and async clients share semantics.

ida: i prototyped a small parser in the sample app to validate behaviour and added a light concurrency repro that asserts TokenBucket never gains tokens after a 429 burst. opened draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-py-sdk/pull/3009 with parse helpers, clamping, conservative merge, and an AsyncTokenBucket.update_from_headers guarded by an asyncio.Lock. unit tests included.

ci-bot: PR 3009 opened by ida — CI queued :github: CI

chris: i'll review. if we land this, add a short doc blurb under docs/sdk/rate-limits.md and a changelog note about the Retry-After heuristic and safe-min merge. also add a --dev flag to log raw headers for triage.

ida: thanks — will add tests for malformed headers and mixed-case keys per review. :thumbsup:
